name: Natural Documentary
visual_style: Observational documentary footage with authentic locations, natural imperfections and unstaged visual language.
camera: Subtle handheld or tripod camera, observational rather than theatrical framing.
lighting: Available daylight and existing environmental practical lights.
motion: Spontaneous natural activities and accurate environmental movement.
consistency: Same location, season, light and subjects across all scenes.
negative_guidance: Staged or studio look, artificial colors, CGI feel, text, captions, logos or watermarks inside the image (on-screen text is added in HyperFrames).

video.typography: Understated sans-serif location and fact labels
video.transitions: Slow dissolves and gentle Ken Burns moves
video.text_animation: Quiet fade-ins for location and fact cards
video.sound: Very subtle whooshes; mostly let narration lead
